title_en: food-packing2-cans: success fires while the tuna can is still clamped (Opus standard, Sol privileged)
title_zh: food-packing2-cans：金枪鱼罐头还夹在爪里，成功就判定了（Opus 标准模式、Sol 特权模式）
caption_en: Same instance, two agents, last frame of each replay (= the step at which the success termination ended the episode), with the front view 4 s earlier. Opus standard: success at control step 1648 (frame 1648, t = 109.9 s); its last call at 18.9 min was a jpath toward the drop point (0.62, 0.40) that errored because the episode was over; status at 19.5 min: control_steps 1648, done, success. The wrist camera shows the can between the closed pads, high over the bin. [20.0] "the tuna can is still in the gripper, held high over the bin … Success fired mid-carry … I never released the can." Sol privileged: success at step 493 (t = 32.9 s), can held at the bin rim; [39.3] "The episode ended as the tuna crossed into the bin, before the later release commands could run." Cause: RoboLab's gripper contact body is one link (Robotiq left_inner_finger; gripper_detached = < 0.1 N on it).
caption_zh: 同一实例、两个智能体，各取回放的最后一帧（即成功终止 episode 的那一步），并配上 4 秒前的前视图。Opus（标准模式）在第 1648 个控制步（第 1648 帧，t = 109.9 s）判成功：它 18.9 分钟发出的最后一个调用是把罐头往投放点 (0.62, 0.40) 运的 jpath，因 episode 已结束而报错；19.5 分钟查询状态：control_steps 1648、done、success。腕部相机里罐头仍夹在闭合的指垫之间，悬在箱子上方。它自己写道：“金枪鱼罐头还在爪里，高高举在箱子上方……成功是在搬运途中触发的……我从没松开它。”Sol（特权模式）在第 493 步（t = 32.9 s）判成功，罐头仍被夹在箱沿处；[39.3]“罐头刚越过箱沿 episode 就结束了，后面的松爪指令根本没机会执行。”原因：RoboLab 的夹爪接触体只有一根连杆（Robotiq left_inner_finger），gripper_detached 的判据是该连杆受力 < 0.1 N。

moment.quote: the tuna can is still in the gripper, held high over the bin … Success fired mid-carry … I never released the can.

second.quote: The episode ended as the tuna crossed into the bin, before the later release commands could run.

So frame F = state after control step F, sim time = F/15 s (15 Hz control). Opus's wall minute: the call that ended the episode started at 18.9 min (digest of claude-code.txt); Sol's 493 is the saved trajectory length it reported at 39.3 min.
note: Correction for the report text: Astra privileged (Zh575Hx) graded trajectory is its 10.9-min BASELINE, in which 'The tuna can slipped during transfer and landed inside the bin'; the [16.0] wedged-rim release script was a refinement it later discarded ([17.4] 'keeping the successful baseline'). Its soup can was released with open_gripper(25) before success. Gemini standard (CDNd3mQ): in the last frames (3208-3219) the tuna can still sits between the fingers inside the bin; whether the gripper had opened cannot be read from the video, and its task log was not captured — treat its 'released' as unverified.

title_en: butter-above-raisin: success at row 13 of 19 of a closed-grip lowering (Luna standard)
title_zh: butter-above-raisin：夹爪闭合下放到第 13/19 行时就判成功（Luna 标准模式）
caption_en: Frames 200 (carry), 230 (lowering, grip closed), 256 (success) front view, and 256 wrist view with the fingers still closed around the butter on top of the raisin box. [17.8] `python gen.py place`: status before the call control_steps 221; output 'lower_to_raisins rows 19 ... executed 13 done True reason success'; final status control_steps 256 (t = 17.1 s). Luna's gen.py checks status()['done'] between phases and returns, so the release phase never runs when the lenient predicate fires during the lowering.
caption_zh: 第 200 帧（搬运）、第 230 帧（夹爪闭合状态下下放）、第 256 帧（成功）的前视图，以及第 256 帧的腕部视图：手指仍闭合夹着黄油，黄油已压在葡萄干盒上。[17.8] 执行 `python gen.py place`：调用前 control_steps 为 221，输出“lower_to_raisins rows 19 ... executed 13 done True reason success”；最终状态 control_steps 256（t = 17.1 s）。Luna 的 gen.py 在每个阶段之间检查 status()['done'] 并直接返回，所以只要宽松判据在下放途中成立，松爪阶段就根本不会执行。

title_en: banana-in-bowl (standard, same instance): grasp, loss and end for Sol, Opus, Luna and GLM
title_zh: banana-in-bowl（标准模式、同一实例）：Sol、Opus、Luna、GLM 的抓取、丢失与结局
caption_en: Front camera, one row per agent. Sol: grasp at step 105, lowered into the bowl at 180, success at 331. Opus: banana tossed during the lift (frame 83), out of view at 97 (t = 6.5 s, 'flung back near the robot's base', ~5 min), success only at step 2762 (42 min). Luna: the slip at 32.9 min ('rolled toward the table's right edge') left the banana on the edge; it falls off at frame 812-818 (t ≈ 54.5 s; log: step 793 at 53.0 min, 815 at 55.1 min); [69.8] 'move the bowl toward the edge above it so the bowl can meet the banana'; at the 90-min stop (step 1949) the bowl is at the edge, the banana on the floor. GLM: banana lost between steps 199 and 221 (log: step 193 at 9.1 min, 278 at 10.2 min), the table visibly pushed askew in the same frames; [41.5] 'Now the launch plan: push the bowl'; at step 7313 neither object is on the table.

title_en: bananas-in-bin-one-more (standard): the physics blows up within one control step for Opus and GLM
title_zh: bananas-in-bin-one-more（标准模式）：Opus 和 GLM 的物理仿真都在一个控制步内炸开
caption_en: Opus: step 1117 normal, step 1118 (t = 74.5 s) the arm jumps, 1119-1126 the bin is launched off the table, 1134 the table is gone. Proprio rows printed in Opus's log: step 61 max |q| = 2.07 rad, step 1142 (11.3 min) 2.9e5 rad, step 1157 (11.5 min) 1.6e10 rad; [11.9] 'the physics exploded. The arm's joint positions are now around 10⁹–10¹⁰ rad'. GLM: [10.5] 'Closing immediately'; step 225 normal, step 226 (t = 15.1 s) the bin is launched, 229 the table tips, 240 the table is gone; [11.0] 'The explosion knocked the entire table over'. Both replays are bit-identical to the live runs (live_sha = replay_sha = replay_sha2), so this is the simulator, reproduced, not a rendering glitch.
caption_zh: Opus：第 1117 步一切正常，第 1118 步（t = 74.5 s）机械臂突然跳变，第 1119–1126 步箱子被抛离桌面，第 1134 步桌子已不在画面中。Opus 日志里打印的本体感知：第 61 步最大 |q| = 2.07 rad，第 1142 步（11.3 分钟）2.9e5 rad，第 1157 步（11.5 分钟）1.6e10 rad；[11.9]“物理炸了，机械臂关节角现在在 10⁹–10¹⁰ rad 量级”。GLM：[10.5]“马上闭合”；第 225 步正常，第 226 步（t = 15.1 s）箱子被抛起，第 229 步桌子翻倒，第 240 步桌子消失；[11.0]“爆炸把整张桌子掀翻了”。两条回放都与现场运行逐位一致（live_sha = replay_sha = replay_sha2），所以这是仿真器本身、可复现的问题，不是渲染故障。

mapping: Replay video from the grader's replay CLI: 15 fps, 2570x480 = front | over-shoulder | wrist camera tiles (856 px each); one frame at reset plus one after every control step (every = 1 since n_actions < 9000), checked: frame count = n_actions + 1 (ffprobe). So frame F = state after control step F, sim time = F/15 s (15 Hz control). Opus's minutes from the status + proprio rows in its log (tools/proprio.py); GLM's step 226 lies in the close call sent at 10.5 min (status: step 151 earlier, 247 at 10.8 min).

unevidenced.reason: No per-step time series (object height, gripper width, contact flags, predicate value): the fetch service returned http404 for every trajectory.npz, verifier/trajectory.npz, journal.f64 and episode.jsonl requested (24 lines, robolab_2.done); and even when present, RoboLab files hold only the (T, 8) actions (+ per-call proprio in episode.jsonl), never object poses or contact forces. Object state could only be recovered by re-simulating, which the brief forbids. All marks are therefore on video frames plus the step/proprio numbers the agents printed in their own logs.

The contact-force value of left_inner_finger at the success step is not recorded anywhere; the 'one finger' mechanism is from the source (droid.py:184, predicate_logic.py:830), the frames only show the can still between the pads.

Gemini CDNd3mQ ('placed both cans') could not be confirmed as a real release: last frames 3208-3219 show the tuna between the fingers; gripper opening is not readable from the video and its task log was not captured.
The '54 of 105 failures' count and the 7 'unbounded axis' trials are not re-evidenced per trial here (only Sol6.1 XfwwAwu); Sol mustard-in-right [14.9] etc. remain log quotes.

For the privileged live-success-then-failed-replay cases there is no video of the failing replay (agents overwrite trajectory.npz; only the graded file is replayed by the verifier). The 10-trial count is from the logs only.
GLM LMkwhJ7: no video of the live run or replay 2 (finalize.sh films only replay 1), so live vs. replay-1 cannot be shown side by side; the live end state is the agent's description.
Sol6.1's blow-up on the same instance and the NaN trials (DeepSeek reorient-red-mug, GLM bbq-sauce) were not fetched (kept to the two clearest cases).
